record_fields.id: OSL object id (@oid), or a synthetic "co:<name>" id for compound-only entries that have no OID in the OSL
record_fields.name: OSL sign/form/compound name
record_fields.unicode_sequence: OSL encoded multi-codepoint sequence when no single glyph exists (@useq)
record_fields.unicode_age: Unicode version the glyph was added in (@uage)
record_fields.unicode_pua: Private Use Area codepoint for signs not yet in the official Unicode cuneiform block (@upua)
record_fields.readings_historical: historical / withdrawn values, kept for provenance (@v-)
record_fields.sign_lists: references to historical sign lists, e.g. LAK, MZL, ABZL (@list)
record_fields.deprecated: true if the OSL marks this entry as withdrawn/superseded (@sign- / @form-)
record_fields.placeholder_glyph_flag: true if the glyph is a technical placeholder rather than a properly encoded character (@fake)
record_fields.extra_fields: any other recognised OSL tag not mapped to a dedicated field above, kept verbatim so nothing is silently discarded
record_fields.note_no_independent_entry: present only on compound_only records: explains that this is an attested compound name without its own sign entry/OID

0.4.1: Fixed: @sign-/@form- (deprecated entries) were merged into the preceding record and overwrote its @oid. They are now parsed as their own, correctly attributed records.
Added fields: readings_historical, unicode_pua, provisional_names, placeholder_glyph_flag, extra_fields.
Added optional import of @compoundonly entries as record_type compound_only with a synthetic id.
